nodes.label: The sound of craft: a walk through the textile galleries, English · textile collection · 196 MB, Wi-Fi required, Hide chapters, The first spinning wheel, Begin beside the spinning wheel and examine the worn treadle. A weaver describes learning to keep the thread steady while watching the changing bundle of fiber., Choosing a fiber, At the fiber cabinet, compare the wool and flax samples. This chapter explains how their different textures influenced the cloth a workshop could make., Colors from the garden, Listen beside the dye pots to learn how plants produced familiar colors. Look for the small sample cards that record each workshop recipe., Setting the loom, Stand near the large loom and follow the line of its threads. The narrator describes preparing a pattern before the first row of cloth was woven., A pattern shared, The pattern books preserve ideas passed between makers. Pause at the open page while a designer explains adapting a familiar motif for a new commission., Mending a favorite coat, At the mending table, listen to a repairer describe choosing a patch. The nearby coat shows how careful work can preserve a garment for another generation., Cloth at the market, The market display follows a finished bolt from workshop to customer. Short memories describe measuring, bargaining, and choosing fabric for a special family occasion., Makers working today, Finish beside the contemporary textiles. The closing voices describe the tools they still use and invite you to compare their work with the older cloth nearby., ✓, Wi-Fi only, Get audio, End of observed component

nodes.label: The sound of craft: a walk through the textile galleries, English · textile collection · 196 MB, Wi-Fi required, Hide chapters, The first spinning wheel, Begin beside the spinning wheel and examine the worn treadle. This chapter explains how their different textures influenced the cloth a workshop could make., Colors from the garden, Listen beside the dye pots to learn how plants produced familiar colors. Look for the small sample cards that record each workshop recipe., Setting the loom, Stand near the large loom and follow the line of its threads. The narrator describes preparing a pattern before the first row of cloth was woven., A pattern shared, The pattern books preserve ideas passed between makers. Pause at the open page while a designer explains adapting a familiar motif for a new commission., Mending a favorite coat, At the mending table, listen to a repairer describe choosing a patch. The nearby coat shows how careful work can preserve a garment for another generation., Cloth at the market, The market display follows a finished bolt from workshop to customer. Short memories describe measuring, bargaining, and choosing fabric for a special family occasion., Makers working today, Finish beside the contemporary textiles. The closing voices describe the tools they still use and invite you to compare their work with the older cloth nearby., ✓, Wi-Fi only, Get audio, End of observed component
